subject.title: Implement RFC 0024 localization runtime and product coverage

question: Should OpenClaw continue sponsoring RFC 0024 as a core, multi-surface localization program and sequence the existing dependency stack for landing?
rationale: The RFC provides direction context, but the rollout adds a shared runtime, protected automation, and many owner-surface obligations; only maintainers can confirm the active core-product commitment and landing sequence.

options.title: Sponsor staged rollout
options.body: Confirm the accepted direction, name reviewers for the shared runtime and trusted workflow, and land the bounded prerequisites one at a time before owner slices.

options.title: Pause and narrow scope
options.body: Keep the tracker open but reduce it to a smaller maintainer-approved localization boundary before accepting the dependent stack.

recommendation.title: Sponsor staged rollout
recommendation.body: Confirm the accepted direction, name reviewers for the shared runtime and trusted workflow, and land the bounded prerequisites one at a time before owner slices.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked pull requests consistently name Patrick as the primary reviewer for the implementation stack.
